message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a fairly quick operation relative to its size. In practice, the tower is repainted every seven years, and the actual painting work takes roughly **two weeks**. During that period, crews clean the structure, apply a protective primer, and then spray the final coat of paint—all while working at heights up to 324 m (1,063 ft).
